name: lr-cross-border
description: Classifies Liberia-source payments and nonresident business exposure for 2026, including ordinary resident and nonresident withholding, software income, asset acquisitions and the new permanent-establishment time tests. Use for Liberia nonresident tax, overseas services, software royalties, an offshore invoice, a foreign branch, withholding, a foreign tax credit or a treaty claim. The Guide separates gross withholding from a binding multi-year election for ordinary net-basis taxation and identifies special extractive-project rates. Treaty availability and entitlement require the actual instrument; this pack does not publish an assumed treaty-rate table. It is a source-cited partial draft with specific gaps for transitional PE counting, current forms and unusual payments.
